heading: Self-contained and lean forms
text:
## Self-contained and lean forms [NDET.7]

[NDET.7] A replay or verification path must obtain the DSC bytes — from
the stream's embedded front if present, otherwise from a supplied
`.dsc` — and verify them against the session header's `dsc_hash`
([NDET.3], [RFCS.4.5]) before replaying; a mismatch is fatal. An
integrator must dispatch on the leading atom's field number ([RFCS.13.3]) to
tell a self-contained file (`DscHeader` first) from a lean one (`StreamHeader`
first).
